# awscc_apiportal_discovery_enablement (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::DiscoveryEnablement. Starts API discovery for an AWS::APIPortal::DiscoveryConfiguration or AWS::APIPortal::OrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration while it exists, and stops discovery when it is deleted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `discovery_enablement_id` (String) The ARN of the account discovery configuration or organization discovery configuration to run discovery for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_discovery_enablement.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ARN of the account discovery configuration or organization discovery configuration to run discovery for

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:
